## Goal

What outcome does this change serve?

## Change

What changed, and why does it belong at this layer of VP?

## Evidence

How was the change checked? Include commands, scenarios, and observed results.

## Falsification

What result would show that this change is ineffective or wrong?

## Limitations

What failed, was skipped, or remains uncertain?

## Checklist

- [ ] Canonical material remains platform-neutral.
- [ ] Relative links resolve.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` and `README.md` routing is current.
- [ ] User-visible changes appear under “Unreleased” in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] No secrets or private data are included.
